description: This Java source file defines the class KafkaAuthenticationSpecificConfig, which manages the configuration of SASL authentication mechanisms for Kafka connections, including validation and application of specific authentication settings within Kafka producer properties.

classes.name: KafkaAuthenticationSpecificConfig
classes.description: Final class responsible for handling Kafka SASL authentication configuration, including singleton pattern implementation, validation, and application of security settings.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of KafkaAuthenticationSpecificConfig, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: isApplicable
methods.description: Checks if the connection has both username and password present, indicating authentication is applicable.

methods.name: validateOrThrow
methods.description: Validates the connection's SASL configuration; throws an exception if invalid.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Validates whether the connection's SASL mechanism configuration is valid.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies the SASL configuration settings to the provided producer properties map based on the connection's credentials and specific config.
